lines.zh: 蹒跚前行，腐肉步履沉重
蹒跚走动，骨节嘎吱作响
蹒跚移动，骨骼隐约可见
我一步一顿，脚踝拖在身后。
lines.en: I lurch forward, my ankle dragging behind.

lines.zh: 咬痕还在流，我照样往前走。
lines.en: My bite wound still seeps, and still I walk.

lines.zh: 腐肉堆积如山，空洞目光呆滞
lines.en: Flesh piled high, hollow gaze blank

lines.zh: 空洞眼神，腐肉堆积如山
我站着摇晃，忘了自己要去哪。
lines.en: I sway on my feet, forgetting where I was going.
Gaze like a blade, flesh taut

lines.zh: 我抬起脸，半张皮挂在颧骨上。
lines.en: I lift my face, half the skin hanging off my cheekbone.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脖子，喉咙动了动。
lines.en: I stare at your neck and my throat moves.

lines.zh: 腐烂的皮肉在疼痛地挣扎。
lines.en: The rotting flesh struggles in pain.

lines.zh: 我的肢体开始变得迟钝。
lines.en: My limbs are starting to feel numb.
Green pus oozes from the wound.
A crack echoes as bones snap.

lines.zh: 我跌倒了，伤口流出鲜血。
溺水的痛苦让我喘不过气。
你手里的罐头，声音很脆。
lines.en: That can in your hand rattles so crisply.
You take a step back; I drag a step forward.

lines.zh: 你一瘸一拐，正好跟我作伴。
lines.en: You limp too; we could keep each other company.

lines.zh: 我的腐肉蹭到你袖子上了。
lines.en: My rotten flesh has smeared onto your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我撞进你怀里，牙齿先到。
lines.en: I stumble into your arms, teeth first.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我的骨头咯咯响。
lines.en: We collide, and my bones rattle.

lines.zh: 第二十八号和谁，都一样。
lines.en: Number twenty-eight and anyone; it makes no difference.

lines.zh: 我的同伴，也在这条街上。
lines.en: My mate is on this street too.

lines.zh: 这条街上只剩我们两个会动。
lines.en: On this street only the two of us still move.

lines.zh: 我手上这层皮，一碰就掉。
lines.en: The skin on my hands peels at a touch.
I need to find something to eat.

lines.zh: 皮一碰就掉，肚子却还饿。
lines.en: My skin sloughs at a touch, yet I am still hungry.

lines.zh: 你蹲在车后，车窗映出你。
lines.en: You crouch behind the car; its window shows you.

lines.zh: 我闻到你自己包扎的血。
lines.en: I smell the blood you bandaged.

lines.zh: 你咳了一声，我就知道你在哪。
lines.en: You coughed once, and I know where you are.

lines.zh: 活人的味道，从那边飘来。
lines.en: The smell of the living drifts from over there.

lines.zh: 我认得那件衣服，之前有人穿过。
lines.en: I know that coat; someone wore it before.

lines.zh: 你不用跑，我已经咬过你了。
lines.en: No need to run; I have already bitten you.
I hug the wall and scrape toward you.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，只为了抓住你。
lines.en: I raise my hand only to grab you.

lines.zh: 我这一身腐肉，就等你咬回来。
lines.en: This rotting body is waiting for you to bite back.

lines.zh: 我将把你变成我的同类。
lines.en: I’ll turn you into one of us.

lines.zh: 我拖着断腿，慢慢堵住门口。
lines.en: Dragging my broken leg, I slowly block the door.

lines.zh: 尸变在你体内发作，只差时间。
lines.en: The turn is working inside you; it only needs time.

lines.zh: 我盯着你缠绷带的手臂。
lines.en: I stare at your bandaged arm.

lines.zh: 我的手举起来，指着你的方向。
lines.en: I raise my hand and point your way.
The more you run, the faster you bleed.
I am in no hurry; you will stop eventually.

lines.zh: 我记住了你躲进的这间屋子。
lines.en: I have noted the room you hid in.
I lick my teeth and wait for you to open the door.

lines.zh: 这两只手烂了，抓力还在。
lines.en: These hands rotted, but the grip remains.

lines.zh: 你的血肉之躯，我的盛宴！

lines.en: Despair, you have no way out!

lines.zh: 痛苦的哀鸣，生命的终点！
我一口咬在你手臂上，不松！
lines.en: I bite your arm and do not let go!
This bite will give you a fever.

lines.zh: 我的指甲在你腿上划开一道。
lines.en: My nails open a line down your leg.
You kick me off, and I get up again.

lines.zh: 我抱着你的小腿，咬下去！
lines.en: I wrap your calf and bite down!
Blood on my face, and I smile.

lines.zh: 腐烂的希望，死亡的拥抱！
无尽的循环，永生的诅咒！
我从路边的车底下爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out from under a roadside car.

lines.zh: 这具身体是第 28 号，我数过的。
lines.en: This body is number twenty-eight; I counted.

lines.zh: 末世的太阳晒着我，我不在乎。
lines.en: The wasteland sun burns me, and I do not care.

lines.zh: 我原先是这座村子的住户。
lines.en: I used to live in this village.

lines.zh: 箭杆卡在我的肩胛骨上。
lines.en: The arrow shaft is stuck in my shoulder blade.
My bones are glowing. Not funny.
